risk: A submitted application could proceed without required consent.
precondition: Synthetic application payload is valid except privacyConsent is false.
expectedResult: POST /applications returns HTTP 400 with error CONSENT_REQUIRED and the record is not persisted.

risk: A network retry creates two loan files for one application, breaking reconciliation.
precondition: A valid synthetic application has already been submitted once.

input.note: POST the identical payload a second time

expectedResult: Second response is HTTP 200 with the same applicationId and idempotentReplay=true; exactly one record exists.

risk: An unauthenticated caller could create application records.

input.note: POST a valid synthetic payload without a bearer token

expectedResult: HTTP 401 with error UNAUTHORIZED; no record is persisted.

risk: An unrecognized occupancy value corrupts downstream mappings.
expectedResult: HTTP 400 CONTRACT_VIOLATION naming occupancy as the failing field.
